One day when I was 16, I had sex with my bf. It was unprotected and I realized afterward that I had missed my bc pill the day prior. I freaked out. I ended up telling my parents and my dad took me to the Walgreens to buy a morning after pill. I was mortified, but so thankful. I hope to have the same openness with my children. I ended up having my first child at 21, and wish I would've waited but I was iN lOvEe lol no regrets though. But I can't imagine being any younger.

I had a friend who got pregnant at 16. She hid her pregnancy until she couldn't anymore. She never acknowledged being pregnant, even though her belly was very large and in charge. The father was a classmate and a *choice*. She ended up giving her son up for adoption because she couldn't bring her baby in the home. I knew a few other girls who were pregnant in high school. Both the high schools I went to had daycares attached to them which, in my opinion was nice. Because these young mothers were able to go to class and get their baby whenever class was done. They weren't forced to do school entirely online or go to some alternative school for pregnant moms. I understand people may see it as encouragement for teens to get pregnant, but seeing how flustered those girls were, balancing work, school and their baby, was quite sobering.
